content: py_webauthn (PyPI package name: webauthn) is duo-labs' Pythonic WebAuthn library, current version 3.0.0 (verified via pip index versions / PyPI JSON API this session), requires Python >=3.10. Root API: generate_registration_options(rp_id, rp_name, user_id, user_name, ...), verify_registration_response(credential, expected_challenge, expected_origin, expected_rp_id, require_user_verification), generate_authentication_options(rp_id, challenge, allow_credentials, user_verification), verify_authentication_response(credential, expected_challenge, expected_rp_id, expected_origin, credential_public_key, credential_current_sign_count, require_user_verification) which returns new_sign_count. Helpers options_to_json() and base64url_to_bytes() handle JSON<->bytes conversion for transport to/from the browser.
